Open with a wide establishing view of a vast green valley surrounded by mountains.

A dirt road crosses the valley and leads toward a distant forest.

The landscape is peaceful, open, and empty.

Then cut to a close-up of boots running extremely fast along the dirt road.

The footsteps are fast and powerful.

Dust rises naturally from the ground with each step.

The camera follows the running feet.

She is traveling away from home and beginning her journey into the outside world.

She keeps running forward with youthful energy and determination.

She does not hold the sword in her hands.

She is not fighting.
She is not posing.
Nobody is chasing her.

Keep the action focused on Riven running.

Follow Riven as she runs along the dirt road across the open valley and toward the forest.

The camera occasionally widens enough to show Riven moving quickly through the large landscape.

Riven reaches the forest and continues running along the path between the trees.

She does not stop or look back.

End with Riven still running forward through the forest.

CUT.

Free.
Adventurous.
Forward-moving.

vast landscape →
fast running footsteps →
